summary: Changes safeGit to return a GitResult object with code, stdout and stderr instead of a stdout string. It also stops throwing on a failed git command and exports the new GitResult type.

findings.title: safeGit return type change breaks both CLI callers
findings.problem: safeGit now returns a GitResult object, but currentBranch calls name.trim() and changedFiles calls out.split() on it. Neither caller was updated in this change.
findings.consequence: changedFiles throws a TypeError on every run, so the CLI crashes. currentBranch catches its TypeError and always returns null, so main.ts always reports a missing repository and exits.
findings.fix: Update packages/cli/src/branch.ts and packages/cli/src/status.ts so they read result.stdout. Alternatively, keep safeGit returning a string and add a separate function that returns GitResult.

findings.title: Removed throw on git failure breaks callers' error detection
findings.problem: The catch block now turns every git failure into a returned result instead of throwing. currentBranch relies on a throw to return null outside a repository, and neither caller checks code.
findings.consequence: After the callers move to stdout, currentBranch outside a repository returns an empty string instead of null. main.ts then skips its not-a-repository exit and reports zero changed files.
findings.fix: Make currentBranch return null when code is not 0. Make changedFiles throw or report an error when code is not 0.
